verdict.rationale: The changelog entry "Use tags as folders when importing from OpenAPI" shows Hoppscotch ships its own OpenAPI import, which generates collections with tag-based folders. A related changelog entry mentions simultaneous imports of collections and environments. However, this rests on a single thin changelog line rather than dedicated docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the OpenAPI import flow (supported spec versions, how requests, params and bodies are generated), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the import works well.
